div.div: نَاعِبَةٌ (K) and ↓ نَعُوبٌ and ↓ نَعَّابَةٌ (S, K) and ↓ مِنْعَبٌ (so in the correct copies of the K: in the L, مِنْعَبَةٌ: accord. to MF, مُنْعِبٌ: TA) A swift she-camel: (S, K:) pl. of the first, and of [the masc. epithet] نَوَاعِبُ, نَاعِبٌ and نُعَّبٌ: and of نعوب, نُعُبٌ. (TA.) [The last pl. is the only one mentioned in the S, K, which do not point out its proper sing.] See also نَعْبٌ in 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
